about.title: About Me
about.name: Alina
about.bio1: Lovely to meet you — I'm Alina, and my story with horses began long before I ever picked up a camera. As a former rider, I know the racing pulse before a round, the quiet bond with the horse and the drive for perfection in every movement.
about.bio2: My military service put riding on hold for a while, but it only sharpened my need to stay connected to this world another way. Today I'm building Lens Dance from the angle I always looked for as a rider: clean, precise, uncompromising photography.
about.quote: "I'm not here to document an event, but to capture a moment in time — a feeling and a memory that last a lifetime"
about.philosophy: My focus is creativity, attention to the smallest details and a clean style — the kind that changes what a "simple photo" means and turns it into a work of art.

qa.q: What do you most love to photograph?
qa.a: Show jumping — the moment between the horse and the fence is the purest there is. But also horse portraits: when they look straight at you, words become unnecessary.

qa.q: What makes you different as an equestrian photographer?
qa.a: My background as a rider. I know the moment before it happens — I know when the horse is about to jump, when the rider locks in, and where the magic is.
Yes, I work across Israel and Europe. Every competition abroad is a new adventure — another language, another climate — but the horses are always the same horses.

contact.agreement:
Terms for ordering photos/videos from equestrian competitions

(This is a translation for convenience. The Hebrew version is the binding one.)

1. General:
This service offers photography and/or video of equestrian events, and delivery of the results to the client.
By ordering the service, the client agrees to the terms set out below.

2. Placing an order:
Photography services are booked in advance.
Please make sure the client's details, the horse's and rider's details, and the competition and class details are accurate and clearly communicated.

3. Delivery times:
Standard delivery: photos and/or videos are sent to the client within 10 business days from the end of the competition.
Delivery during an emergency: in the event of a national emergency (such as war, a military operation or a natural disaster) delivery may take longer. Delivery resumes once the emergency ends, plus a reasonable amount of time for processing. The client will be updated about any such change as soon as possible.

4. Quality and content:
The photography is done professionally, but a perfect shot of every single moment cannot be guaranteed.
The delivered files receive basic editing and enhancement (such as colour and lighting correction) at the photographer's discretion.

5. Use of the results:
The client may use the photos and/or videos for personal use only, including posting them on social media.
Credit must be given to the photographer when posting (for example a tag or a mention).
Publication by the photographer: with the client's approval, the photographer may use photos and/or videos in which the client appears for self-promotion on social media or on the photographer's website.
The client's name should be mentioned when publishing, in order to credit them.
Commercial use of the results is prohibited without explicit prior approval.
Once the client approves publication of their photos, the photographer may use them on social media and on the website.

6. Payment:
Payment details are agreed with the client before the shoot.
Payment constitutes the client's final acceptance of these terms.
If the client wishes to cancel the order before the competition (10 hours before the class starts), they receive a full refund.
If a deposit was paid and the competition was cancelled for any reason, the deposit is refunded in full.
If the client requests a refund after receiving the photos/videos, no refund is given. A request can be submitted for the case to be reviewed on its merits, and the decision is at the photographer's discretion.
If a refund is approved, the client may not use the photos they received without the photographer's consent.

7. Conduct and mutual respect:
The service is provided on a basis of mutual respect and pleasant communication.
If a client behaves disrespectfully or offensively, the photographer reserves the right to decline to provide services to that client in the future.

8. Acceptance:
Payment constitutes the client's final acceptance of these terms.

(This is a translation for convenience. The Hebrew version is the binding one.)

1. General:
This service offers photography and/or video of equestrian events, and delivery of the result. By ordering the service, the client agrees to the terms set out below.

2. Placing an order:
Photography services are booked in advance. Please make sure the client's details, the horse's and rider's details, and the competition and class details are accurate.

3. Delivery times:
Standard delivery: photos and/or videos are sent to the client within 10 business days from the end. Delivery during an emergency: in the event of a national emergency (such as war or a military operation) the timing will be agreed separately.

4. Quality and content:
The photography is done professionally, but a perfect shot of every single moment cannot be guaranteed. The delivered files receive basic editing and enhancement (such as colour and lighting correction) at the photographer's discretion.
